body_markdown:
Park Dental Partners is proud to congratulate Chief Financial Officer CJ Bernander on being named one of the[Minneapolis-St. Paul Business Journal’s 2026 CFOs of the Year](https://www.bizjournals.com/twincities/news/2026/11/12/2026-cfo-of-the-year-cj-bernander-park-dental.html) .


CJ was recognized among 16 honorees at an awards luncheon and ceremony on November 12 at the Renaissance Minneapolis Hotel. The annual award celebrates financial leaders whose vision, integrity and leadership help drive organizational success and long-term growth.


The Business Journal’s CFO of the Year Awards recognize executives who make an impact far beyond finance, helping shape strategy, navigate change, and position their organizations for the future. This year’s event marked the program’s 20th anniversary, bringing together business leaders from across the Twin Cities to celebrate leadership, achievement, and lasting impact. You can read the publication’s online profile about CJ here.


Since joining Park Dental Partners in 2022, CJ has played a key role in supporting the company’s continued growth and evolution, and was instrumental in coordinating the company’s 2025 initial public offering. As CFO, he oversees accounting, treasury, internal controls, financial planning and analysis, and revenue cycle operations for the organization.


“It’s an honor to be recognized by the Minneapolis-St. Paul Business Journal, especially alongside such an accomplished group of CFO’s,” said CJ. “Throughout my career I’ve been fortunate to learn from great leaders, work alongside talented colleagues, and serve organizations that have placed their trust in me.


“Success in the professional world is a team sport. This award is a reflection of the organization’s success and the amazing finance, accounting and revenue cycle teams. It’s a pleasure to work with such a fantastic group of people every day.”


CJ brings more than 20 years of leadership experience across healthcare, technology, and professional services organizations. Prior to joining Park Dental Partners, he held senior finance positions with Calabrio, Digital River, and Renaissance Learning and has worked with both publicly traded and private equity-backed companies throughout his career.


Earlier this year, CJ was also recognized as a Twin Cities Business Notable Chief Financial Officer, further highlighting his impact as a financial leader in the region.


Please join us in congratulating CJ on this well-deserved recognition and thanking him for his leadership and contributions to Park Dental Partners.
